source.publisher: Province of British Columbia — Residential Tenancy Branch

notes: Use the current official form version. Form versions and URLs may change.
A property manager may prepare or serve a form as an authorized agent, but the legal party remains the landlord or tenant unless the form or law states otherwise.
The RTB-1 and RTB-5 are agreements; most other records are notices, applications, evidence, worksheets, or procedural forms.
A form does not itself create authority to end a tenancy, increase rent, enter a unit, or recover money; the applicable legislation and required process control.

landlord_vs_property_manager.landlord: The owner or legal entity that is the landlord under the tenancy agreement. The landlord remains responsible for statutory obligations even when an agent performs administrative tasks.
landlord_vs_property_manager.property_manager_or_authorized_agent: A person or company authorized to act for the landlord. The manager may complete, sign, serve, receive, file, or respond to forms only within the authority granted by the landlord and the applicable form or process.
landlord_vs_property_manager.tenant: The person or persons named as tenant(s) under the tenancy agreement. A tenant signs tenant-originated forms and receives landlord notices.
landlord_vs_property_manager.strata_corporation: A separate entity with specific roles under strata legislation; it is not automatically the landlord or property manager.
landlord_vs_property_manager.practical_rule: Identify the legal landlord on the RTB-1 and use the property manager's name as authorized agent or contact where the form permits. Keep written proof of agency authority.

document_controls: Record the form ID, version date, completion date, service date, serving person, recipient, service method, and proof of service.
Use the official RTB form rather than reproducing a private form when the RTB requires a prescribed form.
Attach the RTB-26 when the names of all parties do not fit on the primary form.
Use RTB-51 to provide an address for service in an RTB proceeding; do not assume a routine email address replaces statutory service.
For a landlord Direct Request, retain the signed RTB-1 and all addenda, the relevant notice, proof of service, rent ledger, and supporting evidence.
For condition inspections, use RTB-27 and preserve photographs, video, meter readings, and appointment records.
For landlord-use or purchaser-use notices generated through the RTB portal, retain the portal-generated notice and the information supporting eligibility.

forms.form_name: Residential Tenancy Agreement
forms.use_when: Starting a residential tenancy or documenting the main written tenancy agreement.
do_not_use_when: The arrangement is a manufactured-home site tenancy; use RTB-5 instead.
forms.legal_effect: Contractual tenancy agreement containing prescribed standard terms and agreed additional terms.

forms.form_name: Application for Review Consideration
forms.use_when: Requesting review of an arbitrator's decision or order on a permitted statutory ground.
forms.legal_effect: Application for review; it is not an automatic appeal or stay.

forms.form_name: Manufactured Home Site Tenancy Agreement
forms.use_when: Renting a manufactured-home site under the Manufactured Home Park Tenancy Act.
do_not_use_when: Renting an ordinary residential unit under the Residential Tenancy Act.

forms.form_name: Request for Correction
forms.use_when: Requesting correction of an obvious error or inadvertent omission in an RTB decision or order.

forms.form_name: Notice of Rent Increase - Residential Rental Units
forms.use_when: Giving a standard rent-increase notice for a residential rental unit.
do_not_use_when: Requesting an above-limit increase; use RTB-52 first where applicable.
forms.legal_effect: Formal notice; timing, amount, frequency, service, and lawful limits still apply.

forms.form_name: Mutual Agreement to End a Tenancy
forms.use_when: Both parties voluntarily agree in writing to end the tenancy.
do_not_use_when: Trying to force a tenant to sign or replace a required statutory notice.
forms.legal_effect: Written mutual agreement to end the tenancy.

forms.form_name: Proof of Service Notice of Expedited Hearing
forms.use_when: Proving service of an expedited hearing proceeding package.
forms.legal_effect: Evidence of service; it does not itself grant an expedited hearing.

forms.form_name: Request for Consent to Assign a Manufactured Home Site Tenancy Agreement
forms.use_when: Requesting consent to assign a manufactured-home site tenancy.

forms.form_name: Notice of Rent Increase - Manufactured Home Site - (auto-calculating version)
forms.use_when: Giving a rent-increase notice for a manufactured-home site using the auto-calculating version.

forms.form_name: Landlord's Application for Dispute Resolution (Current Tenancy)
forms.use_when: The tenant still lives in the unit and the landlord seeks an RTB remedy for a current-tenancy dispute.
do_not_use_when: The matter qualifies for Direct Request; consider RTB-12L-DR.
The tenancy has ended; consider RTB-12L-PT.

forms.form_name: Landlord Application for Dispute Resolution Direct Request
forms.use_when: After serving RTB-30 for unpaid rent or utilities, when the tenant has not paid or applied to cancel within the applicable period and the landlord seeks an order of possession and monetary order through Direct Request.
forms.legal_effect: Application for a paper-based or documentary Direct Request process; eligibility and evidence requirements apply.

forms.form_name: Landlord's Application for Dispute Resolution Expedited Hearing
forms.use_when: An emergency matter requires shorter service and response timelines and urgency and fairness justify expedited treatment.

forms.form_name: Landlord Application for Dispute Resolution (Other)
forms.use_when: Applying for an issue not covered by the usual current or past-tenancy application, including listed specialized matters.

forms.form_name: Landlord Application for Dispute Resolution (Past Tenancy)
forms.use_when: The former tenant no longer lives in the unit and the landlord seeks a remedy for a past-tenancy dispute.

forms.form_name: Tenant Application for Dispute Resolution (Current Tenancy)
forms.use_when: The tenant still lives in the unit and seeks an RTB remedy for a current-tenancy dispute.

forms.form_name: Tenant Application for Dispute Resolution - Direct Request for Return of Security or Pet Damage Deposit
forms.use_when: The tenant seeks return of a security deposit or pet damage deposit through Direct Request after providing a forwarding address and meeting the applicable requirements.

forms.form_name: Tenant Application for Dispute Resolution Expedited Hearing
forms.use_when: An emergency matter requires expedited treatment and shorter service and response timelines.

forms.form_name: Tenant Application for Dispute Resolution (Other)
forms.use_when: Applying for a specialized or other issue not covered by the normal current or past-tenancy application.

forms.form_name: Tenant Application for Dispute Resolution (Past Tenancy)
forms.use_when: The tenant no longer lives in the unit and seeks a remedy for a past-tenancy dispute.

forms.form_name: Application for Substituted Service
forms.use_when: Requesting permission to serve documents by a method different from the normal statutory method.
forms.legal_effect: Requires an RTB order; do not substitute service methods unilaterally.

forms.form_name: Application to Waive Filing Fee
forms.use_when: Requesting waiver of the RTB dispute-resolution filing fee.

forms.form_name: Landlord's Request to Join Applications for Dispute Resolution
forms.use_when: Requesting that two or more related dispute-resolution applications be heard together.

forms.form_name: Tenant's Request to Join Applications for Dispute Resolution
forms.use_when: Requesting that two or more related dispute-resolution applications be heard together.

forms.form_name: Confirmation of Service of Monetary Order for Enforcement in Provincial Court
forms.use_when: Documenting service of a monetary order for enforcement in Provincial Court.

forms.form_name: Notice of Final Opportunity to Schedule a Condition Inspection
forms.use_when: The tenant was unavailable for the offered move-in or move-out inspection dates and the landlord is providing the final opportunity required by law.

forms.form_name: Notice Terminating or Restricting a Service or Facility
forms.use_when: Lawfully terminating or restricting a service or facility supplied under the tenancy agreement.
do_not_use_when: The service or facility is essential or the action requires a different statutory process.

forms.form_name: Schedule of Parties
forms.use_when: There are additional landlords, tenants, applicants, or respondents whose names do not fit on the primary form.

forms.form_name: Condition Inspection Report
forms.use_when: Recording the rental unit's condition at move-in and move-out.
forms.legal_effect: Evidence of condition and a key part of deposit-related compliance; it does not replace photographs or other evidence.

forms.form_name: Tenant Notice: Exercising Right of First Refusal
forms.use_when: A tenant exercises a statutory right of first refusal in the circumstances covered by the form.

forms.form_name: Four Month Notice to End Tenancy for Demolition or Conversion of the Rental Unit to Another Use
forms.use_when: Ending a tenancy for qualifying demolition or conversion to another use that requires the unit to be vacant.
do_not_use_when: Renovation or repair alone; a different approval and notice process may apply.

forms.form_name: 10 Day Notice to End Tenancy for Unpaid Rent or Utilities
forms.use_when: Rent or permitted utilities remain unpaid after the due date.
forms.legal_effect: Statutory notice with a tenant response period; do not change the form or use it for unrelated breaches.

forms.form_name: 12 Month Notice to End Tenancy for Conversion of Manufactured Home Park
forms.use_when: Converting all or a significant part of a manufactured-home park to a different purpose, where statutory requirements are met.

forms.form_name: Three Month Notice to End Tenancy for Landlord's Occupancy
forms.current_version: Portal process applicable to notices on or after June 18, 2025
forms.use_when: Ending a tenancy because the landlord or a qualifying close family member will occupy the rental unit, using the RTB portal where required.
do_not_use_when: For purchaser occupancy; use RTB-32P through the applicable portal process.
As a substitute for a valid statutory reason.

forms.form_name: Three Month Notice to End Tenancy for Purchaser's Occupancy
forms.current_version: Portal process applicable to notices on or after July 18, 2024
forms.use_when: Ending a tenancy for qualifying purchaser occupancy through the required RTB portal process.

forms.form_name: Two Month Notice to End Tenancy because the Tenant does not quality for a Subsidized Rental Unit
forms.use_when: The tenant no longer qualifies for the subsidized rental unit under the applicable requirements.

forms.form_name: One Month Notice to End Tenancy
forms.use_when: Ending a tenancy for a qualifying statutory reason listed on the form, such as cause or breach where the required legal test is met.

forms.form_name: One Month Notice to End Tenancy for Cause by a Strata Corporation
forms.use_when: A strata corporation uses the statutory process for a qualifying cause-based termination involving a tenant.

forms.form_name: Proof of Service Notice to End Tenancy and Written Demand to Pay Utilities
forms.use_when: Recording proof that a notice to end tenancy or written demand to pay utilities was served.

forms.form_name: 45 Day Notice of Availability
forms.use_when: The tenant has exercised a right of first refusal and the landlord gives the availability notice at least 45 days before completion of qualifying renovations or repairs.

forms.form_name: Request Alternate Dispute Resolution Hearing or Facilitated Settlement Format
forms.use_when: Requesting an alternate hearing format or facilitated settlement format.

forms.form_name: Monetary Order Worksheet
forms.use_when: Presenting calculations and supporting evidence for a monetary-order claim.

forms.form_name: Request for Clarification
forms.use_when: Requesting clarification of an arbitrator's decision or order.

forms.form_name: Tenant Direct Request Worksheet
forms.use_when: Presenting evidence for a tenant Direct Request for return of a security or pet damage deposit.

forms.form_name: Tenant Proof of Service of Forwarding Address
forms.use_when: Proving that the tenant served the landlord with a forwarding address.

forms.form_name: Landlord Request to Amend an Application for Dispute Resolution
forms.use_when: Amending a landlord's existing dispute-resolution application as permitted by RTB procedure.

forms.form_name: Other Request to Amend an Application for Dispute Resolution to change address, add or remove a party or remove a claim
forms.use_when: Changing an address, adding or removing a party, or removing a claim from a dispute-resolution application.
do_not_use_when: Adding a related claim or changing an existing claim where RTB-42L or RTB-42T is required.

forms.form_name: Tenant Request to Amend an Application for Dispute Resolution
forms.use_when: Amending a tenant's existing dispute-resolution application as permitted by RTB procedure.

forms.form_name: Digital Evidence Details
forms.use_when: Submitting photographs, video, audio, or other digital evidence on a digital device.

forms.form_name: Landlord's Proof of Service Direct Request Proceeding
forms.use_when: Proving service of a Direct Request proceeding package.

forms.form_name: Notice of Standard Rent Increase - Manufactured Home Site
forms.use_when: Giving a standard rent-increase notice for a manufactured-home site.

forms.form_name: Landlord Direct Request Worksheet
forms.use_when: Presenting evidence for a landlord Direct Request seeking an order of possession and monetary order for unpaid rent or utilities.

forms.form_name: Tenant Notice of Forwarding Address
forms.use_when: Providing the landlord with the tenant's forwarding address after the tenancy, especially for return of the security or pet damage deposit.

forms.form_name: Ending Fixed-Term Tenancy Confirmation Statement
forms.use_when: A tenant is ending a fixed-term tenancy early under the statutory family-violence or long-term-care process and provides verification from an eligible third party.

forms.form_name: Tenant's Proof of Service for a Direct Request Proceeding
forms.use_when: Proving service of a tenant Direct Request proceeding package.

forms.form_name: Address for Service
forms.use_when: Providing an email address or other address for service of RTB documents.

forms.form_name: Application for Additional Rent Increase
forms.use_when: Applying for arbitrator approval for a rent increase above the amount permitted by the standard rent-increase rules, where statutory grounds exist.

forms.form_name: Notice of Additional Rent Increase - Eligible Capital Expenditures (Phase 1)
forms.use_when: After successful approval for an eligible-capital-expenditure additional rent increase and before imposing Phase 1.

forms.form_name: Notice of Additional Rent Increase - Eligible Capital Expenditures (Phase 1 Details)
forms.use_when: Providing the details attached to an approved Phase 1 eligible-capital-expenditure rent increase.

forms.form_name: Notice of Additional Rent Increase - Eligible Capital Expenditures (Phase 2)
forms.use_when: After approval and after Phase 1 has been imposed using the required Phase 1 forms or calculator.

forms.form_name: Notice of Additional Rent Increase - Eligible Capital Expenditures (Phase 2 Details)
forms.use_when: Providing details attached to an approved Phase 2 eligible-capital-expenditure rent increase.

forms.form_name: Notice of Additional Rent Increase - Eligible Capital Expenditures (Phase 3)
forms.use_when: After approval, Phase 1, and Phase 2 have been imposed using the required forms or calculators.

forms.form_name: Notice of Additional Rent Increase - Eligible Capital Expenditures (Phase 3 Details)
forms.use_when: Providing details attached to an approved Phase 3 eligible-capital-expenditure rent increase.

forms.form_name: Request for a Hearing Recording
forms.use_when: Requesting a recording of an RTB hearing.

forms.form_name: Proof of Service Notice of Dispute Resolution Proceeding
forms.use_when: Proving service of a standard dispute-resolution proceeding package.

forms.form_name: Application for Review Consideration of an Administrative Penalty
forms.use_when: Applying for review of an administrative penalty.

forms.form_name: Notice of Manufactured Home Park Rule Change - No Park Committee
forms.use_when: Giving a manufactured-home park rule-change notice where there is no park committee.

forms.form_name: Notice of Manufactured Home Park Rule Change - Park Committee
forms.use_when: Giving a manufactured-home park rule-change notice where a park committee exists.

forms.form_name: Additional Manufactured Home Park Rule Changes
forms.use_when: Attaching additional manufactured-home park rule changes to the applicable notice.

forms.form_name: Contract of Purchase and Sale Information
forms.use_when: Providing purchase-and-sale information connected with a purchaser-occupancy tenancy-ending process.

forms.form_name: Application to Exempt Monetary Order from Publication
forms.use_when: Applying to exempt a monetary order from publication where the applicable criteria are met.

forms.form_name: Notice of Amendment to Tenancy Agreement for Supportive Housing Rental Unit
forms.use_when: Amending a supportive-housing tenancy agreement under the specialized statutory process covered by the form.

forms.form_name: Notice of Rescission (Cancellation) of Amendment to Tenancy Agreement for Supportive Housing Rental Units
forms.use_when: Cancelling or rescinding an amendment made under the specialized supportive-housing process.
